# parilka-unified

> Единый TypeScript runtime для Parilka: durable Telegram Bot API poller,
> MTProto history owner, loopback MCP, SQLite state, provider-routed agent и
> digest jobs. Сначала прочитайте `AGENTS.md`.

## Start here

- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): safety, architecture boundaries, verification
  и routing документации.
- [Architecture index](docs/README.md): стабильный архитектурный канон и ADR.
- [Operator runbooks](operations/README.md): install, state, logging,
  migration/cutover/rollback.

## Runtime owners

- `src/bot/`: Bot API ingest, durable turn worker, agent loop и read tools.
- `src/storage/`: единый SQLite connection/transaction kernel и domain state.
- `src/sync/`, `src/telegram/`: MTProto ownership, history sync и transports.
- `src/mcp-tools/`, `src/mcp-loopback.ts`: operator MCP registry и loopback
  transport.
- `src/digest/`: day/week planning, generation, hashing, process lock и offline
  dream memory consolidation.
- `src/dream/`: per-chat memory consolidator через router role "summary".
- `src/digest-cli/`: `parilka-digests --apply` запускает digest-фазы и dream-проход.
- `src/providers/`: model/provider config, hardened HTTP и fallback.
- `src/vector/`, `src/embeddings.ts`: opt-in embedding index/search.

## Agent workflow

- [Detailed rules](.agents/rules/README.md): читать по релевантному trigger.
- [Completed goal 001](loop-develop/history/001-unified-parilka/001-todo.md):
  unification, decomposition, review и deployment evidence.
- [Loop lifecycle](loop-develop/README.md): current/history и handoff contract.

## Operations and evidence

- [Migration and rollback](operations/MIGRATION.md).
- Audit/research/rehearsal/deployment evidence goal 001 находится рядом с
  завершённой записью в `loop-develop/history/001-unified-parilka/`.
